## Details

<a id="irq_ram_entry"></a>
### [`irq_ram_entry`](../../../../src/irq/raster.asm#L6) `$4852`

*routine*

IRQ entry through the hardware vector $fffe when the KERNAL is banked out. Saves A, X, Y and jumps through CINV.

- **Jumps to:** `$EA31`
- **Reads:** [`CINV`](../../memory-map.md#CINV)

<a id="set_raster_irq"></a>
### [`set_raster_irq`](../../../../src/irq/raster.asm#L15) `$485A`

*routine*

Sets the next raster interrupt: line in A, handler in X (low) and Y (high). Turns off the CIA 1 interrupts.

- **Called from:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`title_screen`](../screen/title_screen.md#title_screen), [`rank_screen`](../game/rank.md#rank_screen)
- **Writes:** [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`irq_next_line`](frame_irq.md#irq_next_line), [`CINV`](../../memory-map.md#CINV), [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ), [`IRQMSK`](../../memory-map.md#IRQMSK), [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR)

<a id="flash_colours"></a>
### [`flash_colours`](../../../../src/irq/raster.asm#L28) `$4875-$4878`

*data*

Background colours of the flash, indexed by the counter $4092: white, red, yellow, light red.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](frame_irq.md#irq_frame)
